description.p: LibreRamen talks directly over USB to Raman spectrometers whose vendor software needs an old, unsupported operating system. The first supported instrument is the Anton Paar Cora 5000 (BaySpec hardware, 532 nm and 1064 nm lasers).

It measures single spectra and time series, calibrates the Raman shift axis against common reference standards and compares, processes and exports spectra. A simulator with spectra recorded on a real instrument is included.
